name: Help Desk
description: A contact form with a shared inbox. Visitors who are not on the space's roster fill in their email and the fields the editors configure; the space's members see new messages arrive live, and editors set each one's status, keep internal notes and edit the form. Every member, viewers included, can read the inbox; nobody else can. Share the frame's public link with visitors: it reaches the form and nothing else. Submissions, notes and fields are the space's own tables (help_desk_submissions, help_desk_notes, help_desk_fields).
